suggestions.title: Schindler's List
suggestions.description: During WWII, German businessman Oskar Schindler saves over a thousand Polish Jews from the Holocaust by employing them in his factories — Steven Spielberg's devastating, essential masterpiece.

suggestions.title: Fight Club
suggestions.description: An insomniac office worker and a charismatic soap salesman form an underground fight club that spirals into something much larger — David Fincher's brilliantly twisted psychological masterpiece.

suggestions.title: The Lion King
suggestions.description: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's murder and must find the courage to reclaim his throne in Disney's timeless, beautifully animated coming-of-age epic.

shown_titles: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
